Seminar Title:

Image-Based Detection of Mold in Kombucha SCOBY using YOLOv8

Seminar Type:

Departmental Seminar

Department:

Biotechnology and Medical Engineering

Speaker Name:

Priyadharshini P

Speaker Type:

Student

Venue:

BM Seminar Hall (BM-140)

Date and Time:

10 Nov 2026 11:00 AM

Contact:

Dr. Prasoon Kumar

Abstract:

Kombucha is a fermented probiotic beverage widely consumed all over the world. Contamination of the Symbiotic Culture of Bacteria and Yeast (SCOBY) by fungal mold is a serious concern rendering the beverage unsafe for consumption and poses significant health risks. Detection of mold contamination relies primarily on labour intensive, time consuming, visual inspection and requires prior experience. Thus, an image-based object localization approach using the YOLOv8 deep learning framework was developed for mold detection and localization in kombucha SCOBY. A dataset of 4588 annotated images comprising healthy and contaminated SCOBY were utilized for development of image based machine learning model to identify and localize the contaminated regions. The developed model works well in detecting and segmenting multiple molds from single SCOBY with a precision of 74.92% eliminating the possibility of misinterpretation of the mold and SCOBY precisely. The developed model achieved an image level accuracy of 79.04%, precision of 66.67%, recall of 83.98% and F1 score of 74.33% on the test dataset. The developed YOLOv8 model provides a rapid and noninvasive solution for visible mold detection, assisting both inexperienced brewers and industrial scale quality assurance through monitoring of large fermentation batches.
